findings.desc: Active user-facing handoff/autopilot/prompt text still exposes retired Authority completion vocabulary after the retirement contract says active surfaces must use local assurance/admissibility wording. `packages/main/src/core/lattice-handoff.ts:1324-1325`, `:1349-1350`, and `:1370-1371` print `productionDone` / `receiptVerified` in normal command output; `packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:1747` still tells users `productionDone=false`; `packages/main/src/core/prompt-registry.ts:110-112` still frames handoff boundaries around `production completion claims`. This violates `docs/requirements/decisions/authority-server-vocabulary-retirement.md:11-25` and leaves active docs/help-facing text outside the local assurance/admissibility vocabulary.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 848905a45. Handoff receipt/worktree/dispatch text now emits admissibilityStatus, assuranceLevel, and evidenceScope instead of retired completion fields; lattice-autopilot manual-review nextAction uses local evidenceScope wording; prompt-registry now says receipt-bundle admissibility, local assurance acceptance, and release-admissibility. Evidence commands passed: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js; npm run test:process-fact-contract; node packages/main/dist/tasks/command-catalog-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/proof-admissibility-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/receipt-bundle-contract-smoke.js; lattice scope_contract_check storyId=B-da34.

findings.desc: Scanner whitelist is too broad for the promised hard retired-Authority gate. Evidence/sourceRefs: packages/main/src/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.ts:104-112 returns true before matching banned terms, including a blanket exemption for every packages/main/src/tasks/*.ts except the guard itself. That conflicts with docs/requirements/decisions/authority-server-vocabulary-retirement.md:80-81 and :87-96, which allow smoke tests to contain banned vocabulary only as scanner positive controls or inside explicit legacy quarantine and require the guard to prove whitelisted legacy files are explicit and narrow. As written, reintroduced Authority Server/authorityDone/productionDone vocabulary or server-backed Authority smoke code in active task files would remain invisible to validation, so M4/M5 are scope-shrunk rather than no-discount completed.

CHK-004:adversarial is not truly covered. The intent says the scanner must fail if active runtime paths import quarantined server-backed Authority modules, but retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke only scans banned vocabulary tokens and MAIN_TOOLS command names. Its retired story resolver rule matches story_authority_resolve only, and assertCommandCatalog only proves the command is absent from MAIN_TOOLS/aliases; it does not reject import specifiers such as ./handlers/story-authority-resolve.js or createStoryAuthorityResolveHandlers in active runtime files. Source refs: packages/main/src/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.ts:33, packages/main/src/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.ts:190, docs/requirements/decisions/authority-server-vocabulary-retirement.md:80.

Active text renderers still expose retired completion fields after the Authority vocabulary removal. The migration contract bans productionDone and requires local assurance/admissibilityStatus/assuranceLevel/evidenceScope on active user-facing code (docs/requirements/decisions/authority-server-vocabulary-retirement.md:13). However handoff_receipt_submit, handoff_worktree_create, and host_dispatch text output still render productionDone and receiptVerified (packages/main/src/core/lattice-handoff.ts:1324, packages/main/src/core/lattice-handoff.ts:1349, packages/main/src/core/lattice-handoff.ts:1370), and autopilot_policy_check still renders authorityChanged/receiptVerified/productionDone (packages/main/src/core/autopilot-policy.ts:739). The retired vocabulary guard misses these leaks because lineIsQuarantined exempts any line shaped like a legacy field projection, including template-string output lines (packages/main/src/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.ts:116). Evidence commands: npm --prefix packages/main run build PASS; npm --prefix packages/main run test:retired-authority-server-semantics PASS despite the active output leaks; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs PASS.
